cards.title: Model Evaluation and Reporting of Translation Uncertainty
cards.claim: Model robustness must be assessed to characterize dependency on data, parameters, and assumptions. Model evaluation should include sensitivity analysis to expose how uncertainty propagates to human predictions. Reporting must include parameter estimates with their associated uncertainty and justify any deviations from the Model Analysis Plan (MAP).
conditions: Applies to all MIDD evidence generation.
Requires predefined technical criteria for model evaluation.
required_inputs: Sensitivity analysis results showing impact of parameter uncertainty on human predictions.
Comparison of model outcomes against technical criteria.
limitations: Does not define specific numerical thresholds for 'acceptable' uncertainty, leaving this to project-specific criteria.
External validation is encouraged but may not be available for novel compounds.
cards.downstream_use: Use to structure the Model Analysis Report (MAR) and justify the confidence level of the prospective human dose prediction.
cards.retrieval_keywords: Animal parameter uncertainty, scaling-method discrepancy and prospective human uncertainty

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
